scenes.alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Royal Palace south front from Slottsbacken in Gamla Stan, Stockholm, in cloudy pre-dawn light
scenes.description: From the cobbles of Slottsbacken the view looks toward the palace’s south front, a long brown sandstone Baroque block with the entrance centered on that facade. The granite obelisk stands on the slope in front of it. Storkyrkan’s tower is off to the west, a separate church, not part of the palace. It is a cloudy pre-dawn, about 11.7°C, still before the 06:45 sunrise, with lamps on and no sun in the sky.
scenes.viewpoint: Tourist viewpoint on Slottsbacken, the sloping street south of the Royal Palace in Gamla Stan, looking toward the south front. The obelisk is in the square. A surveyed tripod mark was not pinned.
anchors: Slottsbacken is the slope south of the palace, running from Storkyrkan toward Skeppsbron
A granite obelisk stands on Slottsbacken in front of the south front
The palace is the Baroque sandstone block on the north side of that slope; Storkyrkan is the separate church at the west end
scenes.solar: Before sunrise. Model sunrise 06:45 and sunset 18:29 Europe/Stockholm on 28 September 2026. The 06:41 scenario is about four minutes before sunrise, and model is_day is 0, so this scene is night. No sun in the frame.
